points.name: 存在句
points.explainEn: Start with a place. Use 有 for things or people that are there. Use 是 to identify a known place or thing.
points.structure: 地点 + 有 + 人/物；地点 + 是 + 已知的人/物

examples.en: There is a supermarket next to the school.
examples.py: Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā chāoshì.

examples.en: There are three students in the classroom.
examples.py: Jiàoshì li yǒu sān ge xuésheng.

examples.en: The library is to the east of the school.
examples.py: Xuéxiào dōngbian shì túshūguǎn.

exercises.explain: 问一个地方有多少人或东西，要用“地点＋有”。“是”用来说明已知的东西是什么，这里不行。
exercises.explainEn: To ask how many people or things are in a place, use place + 有. 是 only identifies a known thing.
exercises.stemEn: How many students are there in your class?

exercises.explain: “有”引出新的、不确定的东西，所以要说“一家”。说已知的“那家”“这家”应该用“是”或“在”。
exercises.explainEn: 有 introduces something new and not yet known, so use 一家. For a known place (那家/这家) use 是 or 在.
exercises.stemEn: There is a café next to the dorm.

options: 我家附近有一个咖啡厅。
我们学校有很多留学生。
exercises.explain: 存在句要先说地点，应该说“学校旁边有一家银行”。
exercises.explainEn: Put the place first: 学校旁边有一家银行.

exercises.q: 翻译：There are two cafés near our school.
exercises.a: 我们学校附近有两家咖啡厅。
exercises.body: There are two cafés near our school.

points.note: 教材对比“有”和“是”两种存在句。“有”常引出不确定或新出现的事物，“是”常介绍已知或特定事物的位置。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Place + 有 (yǒu, there is/are) + Person/Thing; Place + 是 (shì, is/are) + Known Person/Thing
points.noteEn: Two kinds of existential sentence: 有 usually introduces something unknown or new; 是 usually identifies a known or specific thing in that place.

points.name: 动词（短语）+ 的 + 名词
points.explainEn: Put 的 after a verb or verb phrase to describe a noun: “the noun that someone does/did…”.
points.structure: 动词/动词短语 + 的 + 名词

examples.en: This is the book I bought.
examples.py: Zhè shì wǒ mǎi de shū.

examples.zh: 学校旁边有一家新开的咖啡馆。
examples.en: There is a newly opened café next to the school.
examples.py: Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā xīn kāi de kāfēiguǎn.

examples.en: He likes the food his mom makes.
examples.py: Tā xǐhuan māma zuò de fàn.

exercises.explain: “你昨天穿”说明“鞋”，动词短语和名词中间要用“的”。“了”不能把动词短语和名词连起来。
exercises.explainEn: 你昨天穿 describes the shoes, so link it to the noun with 的. 了 cannot link a verb phrase to a noun.
exercises.stemEn: The shoes you wore yesterday look really nice.

exercises.explain: 放在“的”前面的动词短语要按正常语序：地点在动词前，后面不加“了”。
exercises.explainEn: The verb phrase before 的 keeps normal word order (place before the verb) and takes no 了 at the end.
exercises.stemEn: The person waiting for you at the door is my older brother.

options: 姐姐做的蛋糕特别好吃。
exercises.explain: 动词短语修饰名词要加“的”，应该说“他是教我们汉语的老师”。
exercises.explainEn: A verb phrase before a noun needs 的: 他是教我们汉语的老师.

exercises.q: 翻译：The movie I watched yesterday was very interesting.
exercises.a: 我昨天看的电影很有意思。
exercises.body: The movie I watched yesterday was very interesting.

points.note: 先认识“买的书、做的饭、新开的店”；修饰内容放在名词前，名词可作为整句的一部分。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.noteEn: Start with 买的书, 做的饭, 新开的店: the describing part goes before the noun, and the whole phrase works as part of the sentence.

lessons.title: 这条有点儿大，有小一点儿的吗？

points.name: 动态助词“了”
points.explainEn: Put 了 just after a verb to show that an action is completed.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 了 + 数量/宾语

examples.en: I bought a piece of clothing.
examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn yīfu.

examples.en: Mom bought three apples.
examples.py: Māma mǎi le sān ge píngguǒ.

examples.en: I drank a glass of water.
examples.py: Wǒ hē le yì bēi shuǐ.

exercises.explain: “动词＋了＋宾语，就……”表示一个动作完成以后马上做另一个。“过”表示经历，不能这样用。
exercises.explainEn: Verb + 了 + object, 就… means 'after doing one thing, then…'. 过 shows past experience and doesn't fit here.
exercises.stemEn: After I buy the ticket, I'll come find you.

exercises.explain: “了”的否定是“没（有）＋动词”，后面不能再加“了”。“不吃了”是说以后不吃，不是回答过去的事。
exercises.explainEn: The negative of verb + 了 is 没 + verb, with no 了. 不吃了 means 'I won't eat any more', not 'I haven't eaten'.
exercises.stemEn: Did you eat breakfast? — Not yet.

exercises.explain: 用“没”否定时去掉“了”，应该说“我昨天没买票”。
exercises.explainEn: When you use 没, drop 了: 我昨天没买票.

points.note: 这是动词后的“了”，重点说明动作完成；与第二册学过的句末“了”（发生/变化）分别理解。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + 了 (le, completed action) + Amount/Object
points.noteEn: This is 了 right after the verb, showing the action is completed. Keep it apart from the sentence-final 了 (happened/changed) from Book 2.

points.name: “的”字短语
points.explainEn: When the noun is clear, 的 can replace that noun. For example, 红色的 means “the red one”.
points.structure: 名词/代词/形容词/动词短语 + 的（后面省略名词）

examples.en: I like the red one.
examples.py: Wǒ xǐhuan hóngsè de.

examples.en: This book is mine.
examples.py: Zhè běn shū shì wǒ de.

examples.en: Do you want the big one or the small one?
examples.py: Nǐ yào dà de háishi xiǎo de?

exercises.explain: “大的”就是“大的蛋糕”，后面的名词省略了，可以当主语。“大一点儿”只说明大小，不能代替名词。
exercises.explainEn: 大的 means "the big one" (the noun is left out), so it can be the subject. 大一点儿 only describes size and can't stand for a noun.
exercises.stemEn: Of these two cakes, the big one is mine.

exercises.explain: 这里说的是他的鞋，要用“他的”代替“他的鞋”。“他是红色的鞋”意思变成了“他这个人是红色的鞋”。
exercises.explainEn: We mean his shoes, so 他的 replaces 他的鞋. 他是红色的鞋 would say that he himself is red shoes.
exercises.stemEn: My shoes are black; his are red.

exercises.explain: 说东西属于谁要用“的”字短语，应该说“这本书不是你的，是我的”。
exercises.explainEn: To say whose something is, use 的: 这本书不是你的，是我的.

exercises.q: 翻译：I don't want the red one; I want the black one.
exercises.a: 我不要红色的，我要黑色的。
exercises.body: I don't want the red one; I want the black one.

points.note: 学生可以先从“我的、红色的、大的、小的”入手。书中“的”后省略名词，必须能从上下文知道具体指什么。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Noun / Pronoun / Adjective / Verb Phrase + 的 (de) = “the … one(s)”
points.noteEn: Start with 我的, 红色的, 大的, 小的. The noun after 的 is left out, so it must be clear from context what you mean.

lessons.title: 您看看这些特色菜，又好吃又便宜

points.name: 又……又……
points.explainEn: Use 又…又… to say something has two qualities at the same time: “both…and…”.
points.structure: 主语 + 又 + 形容词1 + 又 + 形容词2

examples.en: This apple is both big and sweet.
examples.py: Zhège píngguǒ yòu dà yòu tián.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆又干净又便宜。
examples.en: This restaurant is both clean and inexpensive.
examples.py: Zhè jiā fànguǎn yòu gānjìng yòu piányi.

examples.zh: 这件衣服又好看又舒服。
examples.en: This piece of clothing is both pretty and comfortable.
examples.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu yòu hǎokàn yòu shūfu.

exercises.q: 这家餐厅的菜___便宜又好吃。
exercises.body: 这家餐厅的菜___便宜又好吃。
exercises.explain: “又……又……”要成对使用，后面有“又好吃”，前面也要用“又”。
exercises.explainEn: 又…又… comes as a pair; since 又好吃 follows, the first part also needs 又.
exercises.stemEn: This restaurant's food is both cheap and tasty.

exercises.q: 这个房间又大又___，我很喜欢。
exercises.body: 这个房间又大又___，我很喜欢。
exercises.explain: “又”后面直接放形容词，不能再加“很、真”或“了”。
exercises.explainEn: 又 is followed directly by the adjective — no 很, 真 or 了.
exercises.stemEn: This room is big and comfortable; I really like it.

options: 这个蛋糕又很好看又好吃。
这个电影又长又没意思。
exercises.explain: “又”后面不加“很”，应该说“这个蛋糕又好看又好吃”。
exercises.explainEn: Don't put 很 after 又: 这个蛋糕又好看又好吃.

exercises.q: 翻译：This dog is both small and cute.
exercises.body: This dog is both small and cute.

points.note: 两个并列的特点通常属于同一个主语；主要练常用形容词搭配。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + 又 (yòu, both) + Adjective 1 + 又 (yòu, and) + Adjective 2
points.noteEn: The two qualities usually belong to the same subject. Practice with common adjective pairs.

points.name: 双宾语句
points.explainEn: Some verbs can have two objects: first a person, then a thing.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 人（间接宾语）+ 物（直接宾语）

examples.en: The teacher teaches us Chinese.
examples.py: Lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen Hànyǔ.

examples.en: I give Mom a card as a gift.
examples.py: Wǒ sòng māma yì zhāng kǎpiàn.

examples.en: He asks the teacher a question.
examples.py: Tā wèn lǎoshī yí ge wèntí.

exercises.explain: “问”可以带两个宾语：问＋人＋问题。“说、叫、听”都不能说“＋你＋一个问题”。
exercises.explainEn: 问 can take two objects: 问 + person + question. 说, 叫 and 听 cannot be followed by 你 + 一个问题.
exercises.stemEn: I'd like to ask you a question.

exercises.explain: 双宾语句先说人，再说东西：送＋我＋一本书。
exercises.explainEn: With two objects, the person comes first, then the thing: 送我一本书.
exercises.stemEn: My friend gave me a book.

exercises.explain: 应该先说人再说东西：他给我一本书。
exercises.explainEn: Person before thing: 他给我一本书.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older sister gave me a cake.
exercises.body: My older sister gave me a cake.

points.note: 教材重点是双宾语顺序：“人”在前、“物/内容”在后；只在可以带双宾语的动词后这样使用。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + Person (who gets it) + Thing (what is given/told/taught)
points.noteEn: The key is the order of the two objects: person first, then thing or content. This only works with verbs that can take two objects.

points.name: 结果补语
points.explainEn: Add a result word after a verb to show what the action achieved.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 结果补语（完/懂/见/好等）+（宾语）

examples.en: I finished my homework.
examples.py: Wǒ zuò wán zuòyè le.

examples.en: I understood this sentence.
examples.py: Wǒ kàn dǒng zhè jù huà le.

examples.en: I heard the teacher speaking.
examples.py: Wǒ tīngjiàn lǎoshī shuōhuà le.

exercises.q: 我叫了你三次，你没听___吗？
exercises.body: 我叫了你三次，你没听___吗？
exercises.explain: “听见”表示声音听到了。叫人名字是问有没有听到，不是问懂不懂。
exercises.explainEn: 听见 means the sound reached you. When someone calls you, the question is whether you heard, not whether you understood.
exercises.stemEn: I called you three times — didn't you hear me?

exercises.explain: 结果补语的否定是“没＋动词＋补语”，不加“了”，也不用“不”。
exercises.explainEn: Negate a verb + result with 没, without 了, not with 不.
exercises.stemEn: The teacher spoke too fast; I didn't understand.

exercises.explain: 结果补语要紧跟在动词后面，宾语放在后面：我做完作业了。
exercises.explainEn: The result word goes right after the verb, before the object: 我做完作业了.

exercises.q: 翻译：I have finished reading this book.
exercises.body: I have finished reading this book.

points.note: “完、懂、见、好”等补在动词后说明结果。例句避开尚未学到的复杂可能补语。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + Result Word (完 wán, done; 懂 dǒng, understand; 见 jiàn, perceive; 好 hǎo, ready)
points.noteEn: Words like 完, 懂, 见 and 好 follow the verb to show the result. The examples avoid potential complements, which come later.

points.name: 要是……，就……
points.structure: 要是 + 条件，就 + 结果

examples.zh: 要是明天下雨，我们就不去。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.
examples.py: Yàoshi míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù.

examples.zh: 要是你有时间，就来我家玩儿。
examples.en: If you have time, come to my home.
examples.py: Yàoshi nǐ yǒu shíjiān, jiù lái wǒ jiā wánr.

examples.zh: 要是这件衣服太贵，我就不买。
examples.en: If this clothing is too expensive, I will not buy it.
examples.py: Yàoshi zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì, wǒ jiù bù mǎi.

exercises.explain: 后面有“就”，前面是一个条件，所以用“要是”。“虽然、可是、所以”不跟“就”这样搭配。
exercises.explainEn: 就 follows a condition, so the first part needs 要是 ('if'). 虽然, 可是 and 所以 don't pair with 就 like this.
exercises.stemEn: If you don't feel well, don't go to class.

exercises.explain: “要是……就……”说还没发生的事，“就”放在主语后、动词前，结果部分不用“了”，也不用“才”。
exercises.explainEn: 要是…就… is about the future: 就 goes after the subject and before the verb, with no 了 and no 才.
exercises.stemEn: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go play tennis.

options: 要是你累了，就休息一下吧。
要是下雨，我们就坐出租车去。
exercises.explain: “就”要放在主语后面：要是你喜欢，我就送你。
exercises.explainEn: 就 goes after the subject: 要是你喜欢，我就送你.

exercises.q: 翻译：If you like it, I'll buy it for you.
exercises.a: 要是你喜欢，我就给你买。
exercises.body: If you like it, I'll buy it for you.

points.note: 书中是复句结构“要是……，就……”，表示假设及相应结果；先从生活场景练习。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: 要是 (yàoshi, if) + Condition, 就 (jiù, then) + Result
points.noteEn: 要是…，就… is a two-clause pattern: a supposed condition and its result. Practice it with everyday situations.

lessons.title: 坐公交汽车或者坐地铁都行

points.name: 简单趋向补语
points.explainEn: Put 来 or 去 after a verb to show movement toward or away from the speaker.
points.structure: 动词 + 来（向说话人）；动词 + 去（离开说话人）

examples.en: Please come in.
examples.py: Qǐng jìnlai.

examples.en: He went out.
examples.py: Tā chūqu le.

examples.en: Dad has come back.
examples.py: Bàba huílai le.

exercises.q: 我在门口等你，你快出___吧。
exercises.body: 我在门口等你，你快出___吧。
exercises.explain: 说话人在外边门口，动作向着说话人，所以用“出来”。
exercises.explainEn: The speaker is outside at the door, and the movement is toward the speaker, so use 出来.
exercises.stemEn: I'm waiting for you at the door — hurry and come out.

exercises.explain: “下来”表示向下、向着说话人，所以说话人在下面，就是在楼下。
exercises.explainEn: 下来 means moving down toward the speaker, so the speaker must be downstairs.
exercises.stemEn: Come on down, I'm waiting for you downstairs.

exercises.explain: 表示地方的宾语要放在“来/去”前面：他回家去了。
exercises.explainEn: A place object goes before 来/去: 他回家去了.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older brother went back home.
exercises.body: My older brother went back home.

points.note: 书中介绍“来/去”跟在动作后表示方向。开始阶段用“进来、出去、回来”等常用搭配练习。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Verb + 来 (lái, toward the speaker); Verb + 去 (qù, away from the speaker)
points.noteEn: 来/去 follow a verb to show direction. Start with common pairs like 进来, 出去 and 回来.

points.name: 先后顺序的表达
points.explainEn: Use 先…再… or 先…然后… to show the order of two actions.
points.structure: 主语 + 先 + 动作1，再/然后 + 动作2

examples.en: First I eat, then I do my homework.
examples.py: Wǒ xiān chī fàn, zài zuò zuòyè.

examples.zh: 我们先去银行，然后去超市。
examples.en: We go to the bank first and then the supermarket.
examples.py: Wǒmen xiān qù yínháng, ránhòu qù chāoshì.

examples.en: Read first, then answer the questions.
examples.py: Nǐ xiān kàn shū, zài huídá wèntí.

exercises.q: 我们先吃饭，___去看电影吧。
exercises.body: 我们先吃饭，___去看电影吧。
exercises.explain: “先……再……”说以后要做的两件事的顺序，句末“吧”是在提建议。“又”多用于已经发生的事，“才”强调晚或条件，不用来这样安排以后的事。
exercises.explainEn: 先…再… orders two actions still to come, and 吧 makes it a suggestion. 又 is mostly for things already done; 才 stresses lateness or a condition and isn't used to plan the next step like this.
exercises.stemEn: Let's eat first, then go see a movie.

exercises.explain: “先”是副词，放在动词前面：先去银行，再去商店。不能像英语那样把“先”放在后面。
exercises.explainEn: 先 is an adverb and goes before the verb: 先去银行. Don't put it at the end as in English.
exercises.stemEn: Where shall we go? — The bank first, then the store.

options: 先我们去吃饭，然后去商店。
我先打电话，然后去找你。
你先休息一下，再给他打电话吧。
exercises.explain: “先”是副词，要放在主语后面：我们先去吃饭，然后去商店。
exercises.explainEn: 先 goes after the subject: 我们先去吃饭，然后去商店.

exercises.q: 翻译：I'll do my homework first, then play tennis.
exercises.a: 我先做作业，然后去打网球。
exercises.body: I'll do my homework first, then play tennis.

points.note: 教材说明“先……再/然后……”表示先做一件事，再做另一件事；结构通常按真实时间顺序排列。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + 先 (xiān, first) + Action 1, 再 (zài, then) / 然后 (ránhòu, then) + Action 2
points.noteEn: 先…再/然后… means do one thing first, then another; the clauses follow the real order of events.

points.name: 时量补语
points.explainEn: Put a length of time after a verb to say how long an action lasts.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 了 + 时长 +（名词宾语）；代词宾语放在时长前

examples.en: He stayed in Beijing for three days.
examples.py: Tā zài Běijīng dāi le sān tiān.

examples.en: I watched TV for one hour.
examples.py: Wǒ kàn le yí ge xiǎoshí diànshì.

examples.en: I waited for you for ten minutes.
examples.py: Wǒ děng le nǐ shí fēnzhōng.

exercises.explain: 时间长短放在“动词＋了”后面、名词宾语前面：学了两年汉语。
exercises.explainEn: The length of time goes after verb + 了 and before a noun object: 学了两年汉语.
exercises.stemEn: He studied Chinese for two years and speaks it well.

exercises.explain: 宾语是人称代词时，放在时间长短前面：等了他半个小时。
exercises.explainEn: When the object is a pronoun, it comes before the length of time: 等了他半个小时.
exercises.stemEn: I waited for him at the door for half an hour.

options: 我在上海待了一个星期。
exercises.explain: 时间长短要放在名词宾语前面：他打了两个小时网球。
exercises.explainEn: Put the time before the noun object: 他打了两个小时网球.

exercises.q: 翻译：She studied Chinese in Shanghai for half a year.
exercises.a: 她在上海学了半年汉语。
exercises.body: She studied Chinese in Shanghai for half a year.

points.note: 本册教材区分名词宾语、代词宾语及离合词的时长位置；本表先用最清楚的常见句式。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + 了 (le) + Length of Time + (Noun Object); Pronoun Object before the Time
points.noteEn: The textbook explains where the time length goes with noun objects, pronoun objects and separable verbs; here we use the clearest common pattern.

points.name: 是……的
points.explainEn: Use 是…的 to stress when, where, or how a past action happened.
points.structure: 主语 + 是 + 时间/地点/方式 + 动词 +（宾语）+ 的

examples.en: I came yesterday.
examples.py: Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de.

examples.en: He came by subway.
examples.py: Tā shì zuò dìtiě lái de.

examples.zh: 这本书是我在北京买的。
examples.en: I bought this book in Beijing.
examples.py: Zhè běn shū shì wǒ zài Běijīng mǎi de.

exercises.explain: 前面有“是”，强调怎么来的，句子后面要用“的”，不用“了”。
exercises.explainEn: With 是 stressing how you came, end with 的, not 了.
exercises.stemEn: I came together with a friend.

exercises.explain: “是……的”说已经发生的事，强调时间、地点、方式，不能说将来的事。
exercises.explainEn: 是…的 is for things that already happened (stressing when/where/how), not for the future.
exercises.stemEn: I bought this piece of clothing last week.

options: 他是昨天坐飞机来北京了。
exercises.explain: 说过去的时间、方式要用“是……的”，不用“了”：他是昨天坐飞机来北京的。
exercises.explainEn: For a past time/manner use 是…的, not 了: 他是昨天坐飞机来北京的.

exercises.q: 翻译：I came to China last year.
exercises.body: I came to China last year.

points.note: 教材说明动作必须已经发生；本结构里通常不再加完成助词“了”。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + 是 (shì) + Time/Place/How + Verb + (Object) + 的 (de)
points.noteEn: The action must already have happened. In this pattern you usually don't add the completion particle 了.

points.name: 副词“就”和“才”
points.explainEn: Use 就 when something happens earlier than expected, and 才 when it happens later than expected.
points.structure: 时间 + 就 + 动词；时间 + 才 + 动词

examples.en: He arrived as early as seven.
examples.py: Tā qī diǎn jiù dào le.

examples.en: He did not get up until nine.
examples.py: Tā jiǔ diǎn cái qǐchuáng.

examples.en: I got off work as early as five.
examples.py: Wǒ wǔ diǎn jiù xiàbān le.

exercises.q: 电影七点开始，他七点半___到。
exercises.body: 电影七点开始，他七点半___到。
exercises.explain: 七点半比七点晚，说晚了要用“才”。“就”表示早，跟前面的意思不合。
exercises.explainEn: 7:30 is later than the 7:00 start, so use 才 (late). 就 would mean he was early.
exercises.stemEn: The movie started at seven; he didn't arrive until seven thirty.

exercises.explain: “九点才起床”说明起得晚，所以上课来晚了。“起得真早”等都和“才”的意思相反。
exercises.explainEn: 九点才起床 means he got up late, so he was late for class. The other options mean early, the opposite of 才.
exercises.stemEn: He didn't get up until nine today, and he was late for class again.

options: 我等了他半天，他十点就来了。
八点上课，他七点半就到了。
exercises.explain: 等了很久才来，说明来得晚，要用“才”：他十点才来。
exercises.explainEn: After a long wait, the arrival is late, so use 才: 他十点才来.

exercises.q: 翻译：Class started at eight, but she didn't come until nine.
exercises.body: Class started at eight, but she didn't come until nine.

points.note: 本课的重点是“时间早于预期（就）/晚于预期（才）”；“就”还有其他用法，初级这里先不混入。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Time + 就 (jiù, already/early) + Verb; Time + 才 (cái, only/late) + Verb
points.noteEn: The point here is earlier than expected (就) versus later than expected (才). 就 has other uses too; we leave them out for now.

points.name: 动量补语
points.explainEn: Use 次 or 遍 after a verb to say how many times an action happens. 遍 is for going through the whole thing.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 了/过 + 数词 + 次/遍 +（宾语）

examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.
examples.py: Wǒ qù guo liǎng cì Běijīng.

examples.en: I read the lesson text three times from beginning to end.
examples.py: Wǒ dú le sān biàn kèwén.

examples.zh: 他给妈妈打了两次电话。
examples.en: He called Mom twice.
examples.py: Tā gěi māma dǎ le liǎng cì diànhuà.

exercises.explain: 宾语是人称代词时，放在“两次”前面：找了他两次。
exercises.explainEn: When the object is a pronoun, it goes before the count: 找了他两次.
exercises.stemEn: I looked for him twice, but he wasn't in either time.

exercises.explain: 名词宾语放在“三次”后面：打了三次网球。
exercises.explainEn: A noun object goes after the count: 打了三次网球.
exercises.stemEn: Last week I played tennis three times.

exercises.explain: “两次”要放在动词后面：我看过两次这个电影。
exercises.explainEn: The count goes after the verb: 我看过两次这个电影.

exercises.q: 翻译：I went to the library three times last week.
exercises.a: 我上个星期去了三次图书馆。
exercises.body: I went to the library three times last week.

points.note: 教材介绍“次、遍”等动作次数补语，并说明带代词宾语时语序有所不同；练习先用最常见的自然句。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + 了 (le) / 过 (guo) + Number + 次 (cì, times) / 遍 (biàn, full times) + (Object)
points.noteEn: 次 and 遍 count how many times an action happens; word order changes a little with a pronoun object. The exercises use the most natural common sentences.

points.name: 概数的表达
points.explainEn: Use nearby numbers or 多 to show an approximate amount, not an exact number.
points.structure: 相邻数词 + 量词 + 名词；整十数 + 多 + 量词 + 名词

examples.en: I bought about three or four apples.
examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le sān sì ge píngguǒ.

examples.zh: 我们班有十多个留学生。
examples.en: There are more than ten international students in our class.
examples.py: Wǒmen bān yǒu shí duō ge liúxuéshēng.

examples.en: He is a little over thirty years old.
examples.py: Tā sānshí duō suì.

exercises.explain: 整十后面加“多”，再加量词：三十多个。
exercises.explainEn: 多 comes right after a round number and before the measure word: 三十多个.
exercises.stemEn: There are over thirty people in the library.

exercises.explain: 相邻的两个数连着说，小的在前，后面不再加“多”：十七八个。
exercises.explainEn: Say two neighbouring numbers together, smaller first, without 多: 十七八个.
exercises.stemEn: How many students are in your class? — About seventeen or eighteen.

exercises.explain: “多”要放在量词前面：这个包两百多块。
exercises.explainEn: 多 goes before the measure word: 这个包两百多块.

exercises.q: 翻译：There are about seven or eight people in the room.
exercises.body: There are about seven or eight people in the room.

points.note: 教材还给出“三五十、两三个、几”等概数格式；先练“三四个、十多个、三十多岁”三种常见表达。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: Neighboring Numbers + Measure Word + Noun; Round Number + 多 (duō, more than) + Measure Word + Noun
points.noteEn: The textbook also gives approximate forms like 三五十, 两三个 and 几. Start with three common ones: 三四个, 十多个, 三十多岁.

points.name: “快……了”和“要……了”
points.explainEn: Use 快…了 or 要…了 to say something will happen soon.
points.structure: 快 + 动词/状态 + 了；要 + 动词/状态 + 了；快要 + 动词/状态 + 了

examples.en: The holiday is coming soon.
examples.py: Kuài fàngjià le.

examples.en: The movie is about to start.
examples.py: Diànyǐng yào kāishǐ le.

examples.en: Our class will be over soon.
examples.py: Wǒmen kuàiyào xiàkè le.

exercises.explain: “快要……了”表示马上就要发生，所以要快上车。“正在、在”表示动作在进行，不和句尾“了”这样用。
exercises.explainEn: 快要…了 means something is about to happen, so you must hurry. 正在/在 show an ongoing action and don't pair with 了 here.
exercises.stemEn: The train is about to leave; hurry and get on.

exercises.explain: “快开始了”表示电影还没开始，马上要开始，所以应该赶快进去。
exercises.explainEn: 快开始了 means the movie hasn't started yet but will very soon, so it's time to go in.
exercises.stemEn: The movie is about to start; let's hurry in.

exercises.explain: “快要”后面句子末尾要有“了”：我们快要考试了。
exercises.explainEn: 快要 needs 了 at the end: 我们快要考试了.

exercises.q: 翻译：It's going to rain soon.

points.note: 书中第8课将“快……了”和“要……了”并列讲解，都表示情况即将变化；基本表达句末应有“了”。
points.source: 用户上传《标准汉语会话360句3.pdf》，《标准汉语会话360句》第三册
points.structureEn: 快 (kuài, soon) / 要 (yào, about to) / 快要 (kuàiyào, soon) + Verb/Change + 了 (le)
points.noteEn: Lesson 8 teaches 快…了 and 要…了 together; both mean a change is about to happen. In the basic pattern, 了 is needed at the end.
